ocr_read_line — SYMBOL ocr op

• Data kinds: image2d × table → table

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.ocr_read_line(image, model, char_height_px=None, k=None) -> 'dict' (to call the implementation directly, import ocrclassic; ocrclassic.ocr_read_line(image, model, char_height_px=None, k=None) -> 'dict'; from the registry, opssymbol.get("ocr_read_line"))

• GPU: none (CPU reference implementation only)

Usage

Read one text line in an image: segment + classify, rejected characters become ? (table).

> The detailed description below is the original text — the summary and the headings are translated.

Returns

dict

text(棄却は "?"), chars(各字の label, raw_label, box,

distance, margin, rejected), n_chars, n_rejected, line_box。

白紙は fail-soft で text == "", n_chars == 0。
